name: Blocca
summary:
# Blocca
# Bring Your Creativity to Life.

Blocca is a creative app where you can freely place cubes and spheres to create your own 3D artwork.

# Simple Controls, Creative Freedom
Choose your shape, size, and color. Combine objects and bring your imagination to life in 3D.

# Create in VR and MR
Immerse yourself in a virtual space or bring your creations into your real-world surroundings. Enjoy creating in both VR and MR.
